units.source_text: “听着，根本不是敏感性的问题。

en.t: Listen, this is not a question of sensitivity at all.

units.source_text: 啰喀总是能安于自己的工作。

en.t: Rokku can always be content with his own work.

units.source_text: 但是我却总是焦躁不安。

en.t: But I am always restless and uneasy.

units.source_text: 从啰喀的眼里看，可能只是一步之遥，

en.t: From Rokku's point of view, it may be only one step away,

units.source_text: 但是在我眼里看却差之十里呢。”

en.t: but to my eyes, it is ten miles apart.
